About

Co-founder turned operator. I build and run field teams for tidal microgrids in remote coastal communities, from permitting and marine surveys through commissioning and long term maintenance. Before Tidora I co-founded PolyWise, where we shipped grid planning software to four island utilities and learned the hard way that logistics, not turbines, decides whether a project lands on time. I care about crews who work in cold water, about instrumentation that survives winter storms, and about handing over systems the local utility can actually maintain without us. I write occasionally about resilience planning and rural electrification, and I mentor early career engineers moving from software into energy work. Co-founder turned operator.
